description.value: Burger Crush is a BC-born fast-casual burger chain with a nostalgic 80s ethos, keeping the menu focused on burgers, fries, and shakes without unnecessary complexity. The Victoria location on Fort Street is one of three BC locations and offers both pickup and delivery. The menu gives serious attention to vegan and vegetarian diners, with house-made vegan patties, vegan cheese, and cashew-coconut milk shakes alongside classic Canadian Angus beef options.
